name: What design trends are popular for interior upgrades in the Bay Area right now?

mainEntity.name: What design trends are popular for interior upgrades in the Bay Area right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current interior design trends in the Bay Area often lean towards sustainable materials, smart home technology integration, and versatile spaces that cater to both living and working. Popular aesthetics include warm minimalism, natural wood tones, and biophilic design elements that bring the outdoors in. Homeowners also prioritize functionality and open-concept living, maximizing natural light, and incorporating built-in storage solutions to optimize smaller urban spaces.
